summary: ACTOOS ONE - Checkout Flow Auth Guard & Geolocation Testing. All 5 requested features tested successfully. Auth guard blocks non-authenticated users with 'Connexion requise' banner and redirects to login popup. Restaurants display as OPEN (not 'Fermé'). Geolocation button triggers navigator.geolocation and shows appropriate error when permission denied. Checkout continues automatically after successful login/signup. Email/Password login form works correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: CheckoutScreen.jsx: Auth guard properly implemented with useEffect to continue checkout after login
CheckoutScreen.jsx: handleSelectDeliveryMode correctly checks isAuthenticated before proceeding
CheckoutScreen.jsx: handleUseLocation properly uses navigator.geolocation with error handling for all cases (PERMISSION_DENIED, POSITION_UNAVAILABLE, TIMEOUT)
restaurantService.js: isOpen logic correctly defaults to true unless explicitly set to false or is_paused is true
LoginSheet.jsx: Email/Password form works correctly with proper validation and error display
seed_data_creation: Created test user via signup form during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: ACTOOS ONE PWA delivery app. Checkout flow auth guard working correctly. Geolocation button triggers real navigator.geolocation API. Login/Signup forms connected to Supabase Auth. Restaurants default to OPEN status.

1_auth_guard_checkout.details: Non-authenticated users see 'Connexion requise' banner at top of checkout screen. Clicking 'Livraison' or 'À emporter' triggers LoginSheet popup with Email/Password form.

2_restaurants_not_ferme.details: All restaurants on home page display as OPEN. No 'Fermé' badge visible. restaurantService.js correctly sets isOpen: partner.is_paused ? false : (partner.is_open !== false)

3_geolocation_button.details: 'Utiliser ma position' button in ADDRESS step triggers navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(). When permission denied, shows error: 'Vous avez refusé l'accès à votre position. Veuillez l'activer dans les paramètres.' Uses Nominatim for reverse geocoding.

4_checkout_continues_after_login.details: After successful signup, checkout automatically continued to ADDRESS step. useEffect in CheckoutScreen.jsx monitors isAuthenticated and pendingAuthAction to resume flow.

5_login_form_email_password.details: Login form shows Email and Password inputs. Invalid credentials show 'Invalid login credentials' error. Signup form creates new account successfully with Supabase Auth.
